name: RMAN Incrementally Updated Backup 策略诊断
description: 增量合并备份通过每日增量 + 合并到 image copy 方式，维护最新的数据库副本。恢复时直接 switch 到 image copy，RTO 极短。依赖 Block Change Tracking (BCT)。

root_causes.desc: 只做增量但未合并到 image copy。

root_causes.name: Image copy 空间不足
root_causes.desc: 需要等同数据库大小的空间。

root_causes.name: BCT 文件损坏
root_causes.desc: BCT 文件损坏后降级为全扫描。

oltp.desc: OLTP 强烈推荐，RTO 可缩短到分钟级

olap.desc: OLAP 变更量大时评估增量占比

step1_check_bct.sql: SELECT status, filename, ROUND(bytes/1024/1024, 2) size_mb FROM v$block_change_tracking

step2_check_bct_effectiveness.sql: SELECT file#, datafile_blocks, blocks_read, ROUND(blocks_read/GREATEST(datafile_blocks,1)*100, 2) pct_read FROM v$backup_datafile WHERE incremental_level > 0 AND completion_time > SYSDATE - 7 ORDER BY pct_read DESC

step3_check_image_copies.sql: SELECT file#, name, tag, completion_time, ROUND(bytes/1024/1024/1024, 2) size_gb FROM v$datafile_copy WHERE status = 'A' ORDER BY file#
